entries.meaningZh: 失去曲折变化的〔古语；语言学〕
entries.en: The chapter contrasts anaptotic tendencies with the preservation of older endings.
entries.zh: 这一章对比了失去曲折变化的倾向与较早词尾的保留。

entries.en: The recording contains an anaptyctic vowel between the two consonants.
entries.zh: 录音中，那两个辅音之间有一个插入的元音。

entries.en: The illustrator gave the imaginary bird an anatine bill.
entries.zh: 插画师给那只虚构的鸟画了一个似鸭的喙。

entries.meaningZh: 需吸血后产卵的〔雌蚊等〕
entries.en: The researcher separated the anautogenous mosquitoes from the other specimens.
entries.zh: 研究人员把那些需吸血后产卵的蚊子与其他标本分开。

entries.en: The captain marked an anchorable stretch of the sheltered bay.
entries.zh: 船长在避风海湾中标出了一片可以抛锚的水域。

entries.en: Her study examines the poet's retreat into an anchoretic life.
entries.zh: 她的研究考察了那位诗人归隐修道的经历。

entries.en: The anchorless boat drifted beyond the breakwater during the night.
entries.zh: 那条没有锚的船在夜间漂到了防波堤外。

entries.en: The drawing shows the two edges of an ancipitous stem.
entries.zh: 这幅图展示了一根二棱形植物茎的两条棱。

entries.en: The drill brought up a dark andesitic core from below.
entries.zh: 钻机从下方钻取出一段深色的安山岩岩芯。

entries.en: The model includes anelastic deformation as well as an immediate elastic response.
entries.zh: 模型既考虑滞弹性变形，也考虑即时弹性响应。

entries.en: The survey compared anemochoric species with plants whose seeds travel by water.
entries.zh: 这项调查将靠风传播的物种与种子借水传播的植物进行了比较。

entries.en: She collected the seeds of several anemochorous plants along the ridge.
entries.zh: 她沿着山脊采集了几种风播植物的种子。

entries.en: The old map traces an anfractuose river through the marsh.
entries.zh: 那张旧地图描绘了一条蜿蜒穿过沼泽的河流。

entries.en: The angel-faced child hid the broken cup behind a curtain.
entries.zh: 那个有着天使般面容的孩子把打碎的杯子藏在窗帘后面。

entries.en: An angelologic treatise occupied most of the damaged manuscript.
entries.zh: 那份破损手稿的大部分篇幅是一篇天使学论著。

entries.en: He compared the angelological passages in two medieval poems.
entries.zh: 他比较了两首中世纪诗歌中有关天使学的段落。

entries.en: The manager apologised for the anger-provoking wording of the notice.
entries.zh: 经理为通知中令人愤怒的措辞道了歉。

entries.en: The exhibition includes an Angevine tapestry borrowed from a private collection.
entries.zh: 展览中有一件从私人收藏借来的安茹省织锦。

entries.en: The angiocardiographic images were stored separately from the written report.
entries.zh: 心血管造影图像与书面报告分开存放。

entries.en: She checked the date on the angiocardiographical study before filing it.
entries.zh: 归档前，她核对了那项心血管造影检查的日期。

entries.en: The lecturer enlarged an angiographic image to show the marked vessel.
entries.zh: 讲师放大了一幅血管造影图像，展示其中标出的血管。

entries.meaningZh: 英国与澳大利亚两国的
entries.en: The university announced an Anglo-Australian workshop on ocean research.
entries.zh: 大学宣布将举办一场英澳两国合作的海洋研究研讨会。

entries.meaningZh: 英国与加拿大两国间的
entries.en: The archive holds correspondence about an Anglo-Canadian publishing venture.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着有关一个英加合办出版项目的往来信件。

entries.en: The reviewer challenged the book's Anglo-centric account of European history.
entries.zh: 书评人质疑了这本书以英格兰为中心的欧洲历史叙述。

entries.en: An Anglo-Chinese translation project brought the two student groups together.
entries.zh: 一个中英合作翻译项目把两组学生联系到了一起。

entries.en: She found an Anglo-Egyptian trade agreement in the archive's index.
entries.zh: 她在档案馆的索引中找到了一份英埃贸易协定。

entries.en: The panel discussed Anglo-Irish relations through the lens of family correspondence.
entries.zh: 讨论小组从家族通信的角度探讨了英格兰与爱尔兰的关系。

entries.en: The editor removed an Anglophobic insult from the submitted letter.
entries.zh: 编辑删去了来信中一处仇英的侮辱性言辞。

entries.en: The angriest customer demanded to speak to the owner.
entries.zh: 最愤怒的那位顾客要求与店主谈话。

entries.en: An anguiform creature curls around the border of the engraving.
entries.zh: 版画边框周围盘绕着一个蛇形生物。

entries.en: An Anguillan artist lent three paintings to the small gallery.
entries.zh: 一位安圭拉艺术家借给那家小画廊三幅画。

entries.en: The sculptor shaped the metal into an anguilliform body.
entries.zh: 雕塑家把金属塑造成了一具鳗形的躯体。

entries.en: The ancient mosaic depicts an anguiped figure carrying a shield.
entries.zh: 那幅古代马赛克描绘了一个有蛇状足、手持盾牌的形象。

entries.en: The gardener placed the angustifoliate plants beside the broader-leaved varieties.
entries.zh: 园丁把窄叶植物放在了叶片较宽的品种旁边。

entries.en: The students compared the harmonic and anharmonic versions of the oscillator.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了振子的调和模型与非调和模型。

entries.en: The anhungered travellers gathered around the inn's steaming soup pot.
entries.zh: 饥饿的旅人们围在旅店那口热气腾腾的汤锅旁。

entries.en: The calculation assumes an anhysteretic response over the range shown.
entries.zh: 这项计算假定在所示范围内响应没有滞后。

entries.en: The curator contrasted the aniconic shrine with the nearby statue-filled temple.
entries.zh: 策展人把那座没有偶像的神龛与附近满是塑像的寺庙作了对比。

entries.en: An animal-drawn cart blocked the narrow lane behind the mill.
entries.zh: 一辆畜力牵引的大车挡住了磨坊后面的窄巷。

entries.en: The shop moved its animal-free products onto a separate shelf.
entries.zh: 商店把不含动物成分的产品移到了单独的货架上。

entries.en: An animal-like cry interrupted the silence outside the tent.
entries.zh: 一声像动物发出的叫声打破了帐篷外的寂静。

entries.en: The actor's animallike movements made the masked figure unsettling.
entries.zh: 演员似动物的动作让那个戴面具的形象显得令人不安。

entries.en: The diagram compares an anisocercal tail with a symmetrical one.
entries.zh: 示意图比较了一条尾叶不等的鱼尾和一条对称的鱼尾。

entries.en: The ornithologist compared the footprints of two anisodactyls.
entries.zh: 鸟类学家比较了两只不等趾鸟的足迹。

entries.en: The simulation follows an anisothermal process rather than a constant-temperature one.
entries.zh: 这项模拟考察的是不等温过程，而不是恒温过程。

entries.en: The council identified an annexable parcel beside the town boundary.
entries.zh: 市政当局在镇界旁确定了一块可并入镇内的地块。

entries.en: The philosopher questions whether consciousness is annihilable in the final chapter.
entries.zh: 哲学家在最后一章探讨意识是否可以被消灭。

entries.en: The annotative edition includes several pages missing from the earlier printing.
entries.zh: 这个注释版收入了早先印本缺少的几页内容。

entries.en: The botanist marked the annotinous shoots before measuring their length.
entries.zh: 植物学家在测量长度之前，标出了那些已生长一年的枝条。

entries.en: The lawyer argued that the agreement was annullable under that clause.
entries.zh: 律师主张，根据那项条款，该协议可以被撤销。

entries.en: The artist arranged the tiles into an annuloid pattern.
entries.zh: 艺术家把瓷砖排成了一个环状图案。

entries.en: The chart compares an anomalistic month with a calendar month.
entries.zh: 图表比较了近点月与历月。

entries.en: The analyst set aside the anomalistical results for a separate discussion.
entries.zh: 分析员把异常结果单独列出，另行讨论。

entries.en: The article contrasts anorogenic magmatism with processes associated with mountain building.
entries.zh: 文章对比了非造山岩浆作用与造山相关过程。

entries.en: The stranger returned in anotherguess coat, scarcely recognisable to the innkeeper.
entries.zh: 陌生人穿着另一种样式的外套回来，旅店老板几乎认不出他。

entries.en: The illustrator revised the anourous creature after the editor's comments.
entries.zh: 听取编辑意见后，插画师修改了那个无尾生物的形象。

entries.en: The display includes an ansate cup with a chipped rim.
entries.zh: 展品中有一只有把手、杯沿带缺口的杯子。

entries.en: She sketched the ansated vessel before the pottery class began.
entries.zh: 陶艺课开始前，她画下了那个有把手的器皿。

entries.en: The sculptor left the Antaean figure unfinished beside the smaller statues.
entries.zh: 雕塑家把尚未完成的安泰雕像留在了那些较小的雕像旁。

entries.en: Their antagonistical exchanges disrupted what should have been a routine meeting.
entries.zh: 他们充满敌意的交锋扰乱了本该例行举行的会议。

entries.en: The nurse recorded the time of the patient's antalgic treatment.
entries.zh: 护士记录了患者接受镇痛治疗的时间。

entries.en: The historian found an antaphrodisiac listed in the old pharmacy inventory.
entries.zh: 历史学家发现那份旧药房清单上列有一种镇欲剂。

entries.en: The review separates antarthritic treatments from therapies for unrelated conditions.
entries.zh: 这篇综述将关节炎治疗方法与无关疾病的疗法分开讨论。

entries.en: The faded label identified the bottle's contents as an antasthmatic.
entries.zh: 褪色的标签表明，瓶内装的是一种镇喘剂。

entries.en: The exhibition opens with a mural of an antehuman landscape.
entries.zh: 展览以一幅描绘人类出现以前景观的壁画开场。

entries.en: The fishermen loaded their nets in the antelucan darkness.
entries.zh: 渔民们在黎明前的黑暗中装运渔网。

entries.en: The memoir devotes one chapter to the couple's antemarital correspondence.
entries.zh: 回忆录用一章篇幅讲述了这对夫妇婚前的通信。

entries.en: The poet imagines an antemundane silence before the first sunrise.
entries.zh: 诗人想象了第一次日出以前那种创世前的寂静。

entries.en: The diagram places a red label beside the anteorbital region.
entries.zh: 示意图在眼前方区域旁放置了一个红色标签。

entries.en: The archive contains antepartal records as well as notes from the delivery.
entries.zh: 档案中既有分娩前的记录，也有分娩时的笔记。

entries.en: The choir rehearsed a new hymn during the antepaschal season.
entries.zh: 唱诗班在复活节前的时节排练了一首新赞美诗。

entries.en: Their anteprandial walk took them around the lake and back.
entries.zh: 他们饭前散步绕湖走了一圈，又回到原处。

entries.en: She shaded the anteroinferior region of the anatomical model in blue.
entries.zh: 她把解剖模型前下方的区域涂成了蓝色。

entries.en: The illustrator drew a dotted boundary around the anterointernal surface.
entries.zh: 插画师在前内侧表面周围画了一条虚线边界。

entries.en: The student labelled the anteromedial surface on the anatomical drawing.
entries.zh: 学生在解剖图上标出了前内侧表面。

entries.en: An antewar photograph showed the house before its roof was damaged.
entries.zh: 一张战前照片显示了屋顶尚未损坏时的那所房子。

entries.en: The student circled the antheriferous structures in the enlarged floral diagram.
entries.zh: 学生在放大的花部示意图中圈出了具花药的结构。

entries.en: The editor discussed her anthological choices in a short closing essay.
entries.zh: 编辑在一篇简短的卷末文章中讨论了她对选集篇目的取舍。

entries.en: The geologist noted an anthracitous layer beneath the sandstone.
entries.zh: 地质学家记录了砂岩下方一个含无烟煤的地层。

entries.en: The library moved its anthropologic journals to the upper floor.
entries.zh: 图书馆把人类学期刊移到了楼上。

entries.meaningZh: 认为神具有人性的〔神学〕
entries.en: The sermon takes an anthropopathic view of divine anger.
entries.zh: 这篇布道从神具有人类情感的观点来看待神的愤怒。

entries.en: The survey tracked anthropophilic mosquitoes around the village's outer edge.
entries.zh: 这项调查追踪了村庄外围那些好吸人血的蚊子。

entries.en: She compared the anthropotomical drawings in two early medical manuscripts.
entries.zh: 她比较了两份早期医学手稿中的人体解剖图。

entries.en: An anti-abortion speaker answered questions after the public debate.
entries.zh: 一名反对堕胎的发言者在公开辩论后回答了提问。

entries.en: The newspaper printed an anti-administration editorial above the local news.
entries.zh: 报纸在地方新闻上方刊登了一篇反政府社论。

entries.en: The model includes an anti-air position on the hilltop.
entries.zh: 模型中有一处设在山顶的防空阵地。

entries.en: The museum restored an anti-aircraft gun for the outdoor exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆为户外展览修复了一门高射炮。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the prescription for an anti-allergy medicine.
entries.zh: 药剂师核查了那张抗过敏药物处方。

entries.en: The researchers compared the compounds' anti-angiogenic activity in cell cultures.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了这些化合物在细胞培养实验中的抗血管生成活性。

entries.en: The exhibition paired anti-apartheid posters with recordings of protest songs.
entries.zh: 展览将反种族隔离海报与抗议歌曲录音放在一起展示。

entries.en: The pharmacist moved the anti-arthritic medicines into a labelled drawer.
entries.zh: 药剂师把抗关节炎药物移进了一个贴有标签的抽屉。

entries.en: The novel's anti-authoritarian tone appealed to the student reading group.
entries.zh: 小说反独裁的基调吸引了那个学生读书小组。

entries.en: She checked the ingredients before buying an anti-bacterial hand wash.
entries.zh: 她在购买抗菌洗手液前查看了成分。

entries.en: The exhibition showed a scale model of an anti-ballistic missile.
entries.zh: 展览中展示了一枚反弹道导弹的比例模型。

entries.en: The shipment contained an anti-biotic that the hospital had ordered.
entries.zh: 这批货物中有一种医院订购的抗生素。

entries.en: The committee condemned the anti-Black remarks in the leaked recording.
entries.zh: 委员会谴责了泄露录音中反黑人的言论。

entries.en: An anti-Bolshevik pamphlet lay between the pages of the diary.
entries.zh: 日记本的书页之间夹着一本反布尔什维克的小册子。

entries.en: The company added an anti-bribery clause to its supplier contracts.
entries.zh: 公司在供应商合同中加入了一项反贿赂条款。

entries.en: The technician weighed the anti-caking additive before sealing the packet.
entries.zh: 技术员在封袋前称量了抗结块添加剂。

entries.en: An anti-capitalist challenged the speaker's account of the factory dispute.
entries.zh: 一名反对资本主义的人质疑了发言者对那场工厂纠纷的叙述。

entries.en: The professor contrasted the novel's anti-capitalistic themes with its lavish settings.
entries.zh: 教授对比了小说反资本主义的主题与其中奢华的场景。

entries.en: The laboratory set aside a separate budget for anti-carcinogenic research.
entries.zh: 实验室为抑制癌发生的研究单独留出了一笔预算。

entries.en: The historian traced the newspaper's shift towards an anti-China stance.
entries.zh: 历史学家追溯了那家报纸转向反华立场的过程。

entries.en: The editor questioned the article's anti-Chinese political framing.
entries.zh: 编辑对那篇文章反华的政治叙述方式提出了质疑。

entries.en: The curator explained why an anti-Christian tract had entered the collection.
entries.zh: 策展人解释了为何一篇反基督教的短论会被收入馆藏。

entries.en: The essay links the writer's anti-clerical views to debates about political power.
entries.zh: 这篇文章把那位作家反对教会干预政治的观点与有关政治权力的争论联系起来。

entries.en: The final scene felt anti-climactic after the dramatic courtroom confrontation.
entries.zh: 在那场激烈的法庭对峙之后，最后一幕显得虎头蛇尾。

entries.en: The diagram uses blue arrows for an anti-clockwise rotation.
entries.zh: 示意图用蓝色箭头表示逆时针旋转。

entries.en: The playwright wove anti-colonial themes into a story about returning home.
entries.zh: 剧作家把反殖民主义主题融入了一个返乡故事中。

entries.en: The biography describes an anti-communist who later withdrew from politics.
entries.zh: 这部传记描述了一位后来退出政坛的反共人士。

entries.en: The report accused the two firms of anti-competitive behaviour.
entries.zh: 报告指责这两家公司存在反竞争行为。

entries.en: Her anti-consumerist blog encouraged readers to repair rather than replace furniture.
entries.zh: 她反消费主义的博客鼓励读者修理家具，而不是换掉它们。

entries.en: The chart records when the anti-convulsant medication was last administered.
entries.zh: 图表记录了上一次使用抗惊厥药物的时间。

entries.en: The forecaster shaded the anti-cyclonic region on the afternoon weather map.
entries.zh: 预报员在下午的天气图上为反气旋区域涂上了阴影。

entries.en: The clinic's leaflets described its anti-depression programmes in plain language.
entries.zh: 诊所的宣传单用通俗语言介绍了其抗抑郁项目。

entries.en: The review compared the costs of several anti-diabetic medicines.
entries.zh: 综述比较了几种抗糖尿病药物的费用。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the expiry date on the anti-diarrheal.
entries.zh: 药剂师查看了那种止泻剂的有效期。

entries.en: The school invited parents to an anti-drug workshop on Thursday.
entries.zh: 学校邀请家长参加星期四的禁毒研讨会。

entries.en: The economist added an anti-dumping case study to the course.
entries.zh: 经济学家在课程中加入了一个反倾销案例研究。

entries.en: The magazine's anti-establishment cartoons often mocked the ruling elite.
entries.zh: 那本杂志反对现有权力结构的漫画经常嘲讽统治精英。

entries.en: The reviewers requested further evidence for the proposed anti-estrogenic mechanism.
entries.zh: 审稿人要求为所提出的抗雌激素作用机制提供进一步证据。

entries.meaningZh: 反对英国加入欧洲共同体的〔历史语境〕
entries.en: The archive preserves anti-European leaflets from Britain's Common Market debate.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着英国共同市场争论期间反对加入欧洲共同体的传单。

entries.en: An anti-fascist in the novel shelters a family during the raids.
entries.zh: 小说中，一名反法西斯主义者在突袭期间庇护了一个家庭。

entries.en: The delegate outlined an anti-federal position during the constitutional debate.
entries.zh: 那位代表在宪制辩论中概述了一个反联邦主义立场。

entries.en: The panel challenged the anti-feminist assumptions behind the character's remarks.
entries.zh: 讨论小组质疑了那个角色言论背后反女权主义的预设。

entries.en: The ethics committee requested more information about the anti-fertility study.
entries.zh: 伦理委员会要求提供更多有关那项避孕研究的信息。

entries.en: The historian connected the play's anti-feudal message with its village setting.
entries.zh: 历史学家把这部戏剧的反封建思想与它的乡村背景联系起来。

entries.en: The article criticised the anti-foreign rhetoric surrounding the border dispute.
entries.zh: 文章批评了围绕那场边界争端的排外言论。

entries.en: The greenhouse's anti-freeze system failed during the night.
entries.zh: 温室的防冻系统在夜间出了故障。

entries.en: She placed the anti-fungal cream beside the unopened bandages.
entries.zh: 她把抗真菌药膏放在了尚未开封的绷带旁边。

entries.en: The museum displayed an anti-gas mask beside the soldier's diary.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一个防毒面具放在那名士兵的日记旁展出。

entries.en: An anti-globalization group organised a public discussion at the library.
entries.zh: 一个反全球化团体在图书馆组织了一场公开讨论。

entries.en: The novel follows an anti-government activist who becomes disillusioned.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一名逐渐幻灭的反政府活动人士的经历。

entries.en: The contractor tested an anti-graffiti coating on a spare tile.
entries.zh: 承包商在一块备用瓷砖上测试了一种防涂鸦涂层。

entries.en: The journalist asked why the anti-graft inquiry had been delayed.
entries.zh: 记者问为何那项反腐败调查被推迟了。

entries.en: The anti-gun campaign displayed empty shoes outside the meeting hall.
entries.zh: 反枪械运动在会议厅外摆放了空鞋子。

entries.en: The moderator challenged an anti-immigration speaker about the figures he cited.
entries.zh: 主持人就一名反移民发言者引用的数据向他提出了质疑。

entries.en: The committee asked for a clearer explanation of the anti-inflation measures.
entries.zh: 委员会要求更清楚地解释那些反通货膨胀措施。

entries.en: The engineers reviewed the communication system's anti-jamming design before assembly.
entries.zh: 工程师们在组装前审查了通信系统的抗干扰设计。

entries.en: The historical novel follows an anti-Japanese resistance group in the countryside.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说讲述了乡间一个抗日组织的故事。

entries.en: The engineer reviewed the fuel's anti-knock rating before the engine test.
entries.zh: 工程师在发动机测试前查看了燃料的抗爆震等级。
